query: My tablet's screen stays dark and only three app icons are lit while the rest are dark and won't open, so nothing loads on the screen and I can't use the device.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Multi Window Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Multi window fix

actions.actionName: Turn On Swipe for Split Screen
actions.description: It will turn on swipe for split

steps: Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap on Advanced features.
Tap on Multi window.
Tap the switches next to Swipe for split screen or Swipe for pop-up view.
Use one finger to swipe in from either top corner to put the current app into a pop-up.
Drag the pop-up to the side of the screen to hide it.
Tap it again to bring it back to the center of the screen.

actionableDeeplink.description: Open multi window settings under Advanced features
actionableDeeplink.message: Go to multi window in Advanced features

steps: Use Multi window on your Nexa foldable and non-foldable devices.
If you have a few favorite apps, create app pairs!
From the screen's right side, swipe left to open the Quick Access panel.
Tap the All apps icon (the grid).
To open an app in split screen view on Foldable devices, drag and drop it to the left, right, top, or bottom of the screen.
Do the same for additional apps if desired.
To open an app in pop-up view, drag the app to the center.
Tap Recents.
Tap an app's icon.
Tap either Open in split screen view or Open in pop-up view.
When you are in pop-up view, rearrange your opened apps by moving the windows to your liking.
If you need a larger view for a certain app, tap the expand icon at the top to expand the window.
When you are in split screen view, use the dividers between the apps to adjust the size of the windows.
To create an app pair from split screen view, tap the dotted divider between the apps.
Tap the Add to app pair icon (the star).
Select your desired location for the app pair.
To close an app in split screen view or pop-up view, tap the blue divider at the top of the app's screen.
Tap the X icon.
Keep the phone propped open on a desk or in your hand to continue using split screen or pop-up view.
When you want to give Multi window a break and just use one app, close the split screen view.
To do this, tap the Home icon.
Open in split screen view: Open the app in split screen view.
Move the icon around the screen.
Make more than one app into an icon.
Maximize window: Expand the app back into its regular full-screen view.
Close app: Close the current pop-up view window.

actions.description: It will create an app pair

steps: Instead of separately opening apps you always use together, create an App pair.
Swipe left to open the Quick Access panel.
Touch and hold your desired app.
Drag and drop it into the top portion of the screen.
Once all the apps are on the screen, tap the dotted divider in the center.
Tap the Add to app pair icon.

actions.description: It will remove shortcuts from application edge

steps: Add the shortcut back later, or add new Quick Access panels with additional apps that you'd like to use.
